Class Path

Namespace
ShapeEngine.Pathfinding
Assembly
ShapeEngine.dll

Represents a path used by the pathfinding system. Contains the start and end positions and the sequence of rectangles that form the path. Instances are intended to be rented from and returned to an internal pool using RentPath(Vector2, Vector2, int) and ReturnPath(Path) to minimize allocations.

Remarks

Returns the internal ShapeEngine.Pathfinding.Path.RectsList as an IReadOnlyList<T>. Treat the returned collection as read-only: the underlying list is cleared when the instance is returned to the pool and must not be retained or modified by callers.

Copy()

Creates a deep copy of this Path.

public Path Copy()

Returns

Path

A new Path instance with the same Start and End values and an independent copy of the internal rectangles list (created via GetRectsCopy()). The returned instance is marked as rented; callers can return it to the pool using ReturnInstance() / ReturnPath(Path) when finished or keep it for independent use. Once returned to the pool, the original instance should not be accessed further.

GetRectsCopy()

Creates and returns a new list containing the rectangles from the internal backing list.

public List<Rect> GetRectsCopy()

Returns

List<Rect>

A new List<T> containing the path's rectangles. The returned list is a copy and can be modified independently of the Path instance.

Remarks

This method allocates a new list. Prefer using the Rects property for a non-allocating read-only view when possible. Do not rely on the original Path after it has been returned to the pool; the returned copy is the only safe representation to hold beyond that.

GetRectsSetCopy()

Creates and returns a new HashSet<T> containing the rectangles that compose this path.

public HashSet<Rect> GetRectsSetCopy()

Returns

HashSet<Rect>

A new hash set populated from the internal backing list. The returned set is an independent copy and can be modified without affecting the Path.

ReturnInstance()

public void ReturnInstance()

Remarks

This method forwards to ReturnPath(Path). After calling this, the instance may be reused by other code and should not be accessed by the caller.

ReturnPath(Path)

Returns a rented Path instance to the internal pool. The path's Rects collection will be cleared by the caller

path Path

The Path instance to enqueue for reuse.

ReturnPaths(IEnumerable<Path>)

Returns a collection of rented Path instances to the internal pool. Each path will be cleared and enqueued via ReturnPath(Path); after calling this the caller must not access the returned instances.

public static void ReturnPaths(IEnumerable<Path> paths)

paths should be cleared after calling this method to avoid accidental access to returned instances.
